name: saas
description: Multi-tenant SaaS: organizations, users, memberships with a role enum, projects and an append-only audit log with jsonb details.

input.requirements: A multi-tenant SaaS. Organizations have a unique slug and a name. Users have a unique email and an optional name. Users belong to organizations through memberships with a role of owner, admin or member (default member); a user is a member of an organization at most once. Organizations have projects with a name (unique within the organization) and an optional archived_at time. An audit_log records, per organization, who (the actor, a user; kept as null if the user is deleted) did what (an action text), with free-form details as JSON, and when. The audit log has a bigint identity key and is never updated.
